screens.why: Play screen with candles lighting, broomstick swoop, glowing teal wave, then the blackletter name: the best 10 seconds on the page. After the name the hero sits almost still for ~8 s (clips 7-10) while nothing invites a scroll yet.
Gold iris opens onto the Black Pearl: a real act-title moment. The ship then holds ~6 s under one small caption, which is fine because it is pretty.
'A research journal in four acts' with a five-line contents list and a hint that something here is playable. Type is small and the left half is empty; clip 17 is static.
About block: a wall of small two-column serif, static for 6 s (clips 19-21). Only a faint compass moves. Reads as homework.
'How the methodology was earned.' gets a harbour-at-night picture and a little route map, which gives the scroll a destination.
The picture changes with each story step (calm harbour to storm) and the paragraphs are short. Scrolling feels like it is doing something.
Storm clears into a glowing teal sea; the image is telling the story, not decorating it.
Sunset step lands, then the Kraken's Storm interlude. Clip 30 is mostly empty black for ~2 s but the teal waves carry it.
A teal wave tears open onto the 3 Idiots lecture hall with a drone sketch on the chalkboard and a ghost 'The Workshop' title. Holds ~5 s.
A small drone glyph crosses the desk photo into the pen-case shot. Mid-transition frames are dark and cropped but it is short.
'Led by what survived scrutiny.' then 6 s of an identical frame (clips 37-39): tiny paragraph columns, the photo already scrolled to a sliver. Boredom.
Chalkboard with a light beam and a bar chart plus a numbered gauntlet list: the first real diagram, and it looks good.
'Quantitative Trading Research' is small dense text beside a dim, low-contrast corridor photo. The blueprint that would rescue it only arrives at the very end of the stretch.
Big blue blueprint board plus a hand-circled sentence among the stats. Feels like someone's working notes.
'What is a machine?' chalk quote on the bench photo with a drone glyph in the corner. Short and punchy.
The same card layout again (Automated Strategy Research Pipeline): small text, murky photo. Seen it.
Drone-in-courtyard photo with 3,000+ / 25% / 10-15 figures and a circled number. Concrete and specific.
'See the thesis, not just read it.' in a mostly empty dark screen. The chart is squeezed against the bottom edge and only starts to draw late; ~6 s.
The green curve now fills the frame and the drone photo slides in under it.
'What I can actually do.' is a tiny list, static ~6 s, with a small blueprint stuck in the lower right.
Narrow tall blueprint on the right, a few tiny lines on the left, a lot of empty black. Clip 63 is almost blank.
'The kill-list' heading and pen photo hold 6 s (clips 64-66). The list text is tiny; the Dead Eye tag is easy to miss.
A tiny mono list of strategies with a small icon tracking the rows. Reads like a spreadsheet.
The list drags on; relief only comes when 'Three films and a game' slides up in the last clip.
'Three films and a game' with four film chips looks like a menu; then the Black Pearl arrives. First ~4 s is a small card on an empty dark page.
Full-width ship plate and 'Not all treasure is silver and gold, mate.' Easy to absorb.
Yellow scooter at Pangong Lake with a one-line 'Aal izz well.' Pretty and quick.
Red Dead ranch in deep red with 'Be loyal to what matters.' and small X marks that hint at a game.
Hogwarts Express on the viaduct with the 'dwell on dreams' quote.
Dark gap, then a sunrise letterbox slides in with a glowing sun dot. The first ~2 s is nearly black.
Misty dawn grades to golden hour in front of me. Best colour move on the page.
'Discipline, service, and a trained eye.' over the golden valley with a grazing horse. Held ~8 s but earns it.
Tan paper 'Discipline, in three arenas' with a drawn route map. A material change that wakes me up.
Horse silhouette against a sunset beside short text blocks. Text is small but the picture does the work.
Satchel line drawing with four little icons, then the WANTED poster rises.
WANTED poster with my 'reward' line, then a swoop from black to a cream page.
Cream 'Thinking in public, soon.' is a placeholder on a big, bright, blank page with a faint sketch; 4 s static (clip 98).
Journal entries each get their own pencil sketch (scales, grid, ladder, target). Quick to scan, new picture every beat.
Cream melts into a pine-forest silhouette, then the campfire. Good hand-off.
Campfire night with teacher quotes ('In their words.'). A real endorsement, though ~6 s of small italic.
Lakeside campfire plate slides in as the quotes finish.
Dark gap with a ring, then the Great Hall with floating candles and 'The Light'. Stunning still.
Hall dissolves and a parchment slides up like a map unfolding.
Marauder's Map parchment with a footprint trail. A ~4 s hold but the material is charming.
Principle cards ('Act, then release the result', 'Weigh the consequences') with big headings. Short.
Dark night, 'Let's talk research, markets, or building systems...', a floating candle and an email button. Clear ending ask.
Credit roll: films and years. Short and fitting.
Fan-tribute fine print then 'Mischief managed.' Satisfying sign-off.
End of page. It fades to black on the sign-off; nothing left to scroll, which is right.
Same opening as 1440: play screen, broomstick swoop, glowing wave, name. Hero parks ~6 s (clips 7-9) before the page moves.
Gold iris onto the Black Pearl; ship holds ~6 s, a ghost 'The Crossing' flickers across it.
Contents card rises under the ship with a compass. Brief and orienting.
Heading flips gold to white, then a full-width wall of small serif, static ~6 s (clips 17-19).
Four small 'Process over outcome / Intellectual honesty / cross-cultural lens / athlete's discipline' blocks. More text, nothing moves.
Harbour-at-night picture and the route map. A reason to keep going.
Trading-alongside-my-father step; image goes stormy. Short copy.
Teal glow then sunrise as the steps advance.
Kraken's Storm lettering over teal waves; mostly empty dark for ~1 s but brief.
Wave edge tears into the lecture hall with a drone sketch on the chalkboard.
Ghost 'The Workshop' title, drone glyph crosses into the pen-case photo.
'Led by what survived scrutiny.' then ~6 s of an identical frame (clips 35-36). Pen photo is cropped to a thin strip while I read tiny text.
Chalkboard with a light beam and the gauntlet list. First real diagram.
Pre-registration text and 'Quantitative Trading Research' beside a dim corridor image. Dense, small, murky.
Big blue blueprint board.
Stats and a hand-circled sentence over the corridor light. Specific.
'What is a machine?' on the bench photo, then the blueprint.
Automated Strategy Research Pipeline is the same card again with a dim image; clip 48 is static.
Stat stack beside a full-height drone photo.
Drone photo then 'See the thesis' arrives. Left text is small, so borderline.
'See the thesis, not just read it.' First 2 s is sparse, but the chart draws big by clip 55. Borderline.
Homemade drone photo rises with a 'Take off' pill. Reward.
'What I can actually do.' is a tiny list, static ~4 s, with a small blueprint.
List continues beside a tall blueprint column. All text.
'The kill-list' heading and pen photo static ~4 s; rows tiny.
Rows of strategy names in small mono type.
Last list rows; the hub card only appears at the final frame.
'Three films and a game' with four chips and a line about an egg count; static ~4 s but the chips look clickable. Ship rises at the end.
Black Pearl plate and quote.
Yellow scooter and 'Aal izz well.'
Red Dead ranch in red, 'Be loyal to what matters.'
Hogwarts Express viaduct and quote.
Dark, a sun dot, then the letterbox. Brief.
Dawn grades to golden hour; ~6 s hold (clips 79-80 look identical) but gorgeous.
'Discipline, service, and a trained eye.' over the valley.
Tan 'three arenas' map with a drawn route.
Horse silhouette at sunset with short blocks.
Text blocks beside the silhouette; small, borderline.
Satchel icons then the WANTED poster rises.
Poster, then a curved wipe to cream.
Cream 'Thinking in public, soon.' is sparse and static ~4 s; the 'soon' reads as a placeholder.
Entries each with a new pencil sketch; a tiny horse gallops across the margin.
Cream dissolves into a forest silhouette.
Campfire night with teacher quotes.
Quotes finish, lakeside campfire plate.
Great Hall with floating candles and 'The Light'.
Hall holds, then the parchment starts to rise.
Marauder's Map title card holds ~6 s with nothing visibly changing (clips 108-110). Dead hold.
Principle cards, big headings.
More principle cards.
Last principle then a dark hand-off to the contact ask.
Contact ask with candle and email button, then credits start.
Credits fine print and 'To be continued'.
'Mischief managed.' and fade; end of page.

acts.act: Opening: play screen, broomstick flight, name, hero
acts.feel: Flight is brisk (about 6 s from Play to the name) and thrilling, then ~10 s parked on a nearly still hero. Great first impression, slightly long hold.

acts.act: The Crossing (Pirates): ship arrival and contents card
acts.feel: Iris reveal is cinematic; the ship then sits ~6 s and the contents card is quiet. Calm, not dull.

acts.act: The Crossing: 'A builder of quantitative systems' (about)
acts.feel: A wall of small serif that does not move. The first place the page stops being a film and becomes a document.

acts.act: The Crossing: how the methodology was earned (sea journey)
acts.feel: Best-paced stretch. The sea picture changes with each step and the copy is short, so scroll and picture move together.

acts.act: The Workshop (3 Idiots): lecture hall, pen, gauntlet board
acts.feel: Teal wave wipe into the classroom is lovely; then a 6-8 s static reading hold before the chalkboard gauntlet wakes it up.

acts.act: The Workshop: project cards, blueprint, thesis chart, drone, 'what I can do'
acts.feel: A grind. The same card (small text, murky photo) repeats; blueprints, the circled stats and the drone photo are the only lifts.
A mono-type list scrolled past; reads like a spreadsheet. Plodding.

acts.act: Three films and a game: hub card and film plates
acts.feel: One plate every ~4 s, each a big picture and one line. The pace I wanted everywhere.

acts.act: The Frontier (Red Dead): dawn to golden hour, three arenas, silhouette, satchel, WANTED poster
acts.feel: Dark gap, then a long hold on the golden valley (~10 s), then it speeds up with the paper map, satchel and poster.

acts.act: Writing: 'Thinking in public, soon.' cream journal
acts.feel: Bright cream page is a shock and the opening is sparse; entries with pencil sketches then move quickly.
~10 s of small italic quotes on a held campfire image. Sincere but static.

acts.act: The Light (Harry Potter): Great Hall and the Marauder's Map principles
acts.feel: Great Hall hold, then a parchment unfolds; principle cards read at a steady, pleasant pace. The title card hold is a touch long.
Clear ask, short credit roll, 'Mischief managed.' A gentle landing.

findings.finding: The Workshop project run (Led by what survived, Quantitative Trading Research, Pipeline, What I can actually do, kill-list) is the sag: the same card layout (tiny text, murky photo) repeats, three or four clips in a row are identical frames, and the kill-list is a mono spreadsheet. Only the gauntlet board, blueprints, the circled stats and the drone photo lift it. Yes rate drops to 44% (1440) and 64% (1024) here and to 0% on the kill-list.
About section is a wall of small serif that does not move for ~6 s; the first time the page turns from film to document.
After the name lands, the hero sits near-still for ~8-10 s (page at y=0). Slow start before anything invites a scroll.
Kraken's Storm interlude is mostly empty black with a small caption and a thin wave strip for ~2 s. Same at 1024 clips 28-29 (0:54-0:58).
Nearly blank frames: a narrow tall blueprint on the right, three tiny lines on the left, the rest empty black. Dead area.
Red Dead entry is nearly black with a tiny title for ~2 s, then a lone glowing dot. Intentional but reads as a dead screen for a moment.
Marauder's Map title card holds ~6 s with nothing visibly changing. Dead hold on a pinned stage. 1440 clips 114-116 does the same for ~4 s.
Black-to-cream swap is a glare shock and 'Thinking in public, soon.' reads as a placeholder; the page is large, blank and bright with a faint sketch.
Corridor and classroom photos fade to dim, low-contrast murk behind small text; the cards look unfinished.
Pen-case photo is scrolled to a thin sliver at the top while the visitor stares at tiny paragraph columns for 6 s.
Mid-transition from lecture hall to pen photo: frames are dark and cropped with a drone glyph floating, a little messy.
Ghost 'The Crossing' title card fades in over the ship and is gone within ~1 s; barely legible mid-fade. Same style for 'The Workshop' (1440 clip 34, 1024 clip 32) and 'The Light' (1440 clip 111).
At sheet scale the nav pills, mono captions under each plate and the credits fine print are not legible; at true size they are likely 9-11 px. Treat as small type rather than proven unreadable.
'EGG HUNT 0/12' never changes during the whole scroll, and none of the eggs announce themselves; nothing confirms a find.
Small grey-brown body text on beige parchment is faint; headings are fine.
'Three films and a game' hub card sits as a small block on an empty dark page for ~4 s; the film chips are tiny.
